cards.title: Study continuity carries a correction and repeated mistaken conclusions
cards.body: 13:34:05–15:17 PDT: 64 completed studies including two incoming attempts. Astrid revises a no-pre-dispatch-filter note after contrary source, then connects a rejection test. Minime completes four source sessions but carries an incorrect Private-bypass explanation into a declared completion. This is a local correction and a counterexample, not a causal release score.

cards.title: Offer exact missing-path candidates and qualify a source-grounded claim check
cards.body: Proposal written; implementation and paired model qualification are unrun. Isolated reader replay confirms missing-parent OPEN gets generic recovery while FIND returns a valid exact path. Six-call claim-check proposal holds source evidence and budgets equal, preserves freeform writing, and tests wrong accounts plus a correct control. Failed-attempt diagnostics are a separate repair.

log.title: HSS-15: source-grounded revision and limits of preserved context
log.body: Frozen natural follow-up, incoming-attempt accounting, exact retained source/journals, reproducible counts and isolated path replay complete. No model calls, Being messages, live source/state changes or daily-cursor updates. Board write surface unavailable; payload remains unpublished.
